newsitem.title: UK: Barclays buys back shares at 1090.176/share. [CORRECTED 09:38 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Barclays buys back shares at 1090.176/share. [CORRECTED 09:38 GMT]

text.p: British bank Barclays Plc said on Thursday it had bought back 3.88 million of its ordinary shares for cancellation from BZW Securities Ltd at a price of 1090.176p per share.

As a result of the purchase from BZW, which took place on Wednesday, Barclays completed its previously-announced plan to buy back up to 26 million shares, representing some 1.7 percent of its share capital.
The average price for the repurchases was 1112.55p per share for a total of about 290 million stg.

On February 18, Barclays said (corrects by making date of statement clear) "Given current business conditions, and in the absence of compelling alternative uses for the money, we would expect to return equity capital to a value of some 500 million stg to shareholders during the next 12 months," Barclays said in a statement.
The latest buyback plan was the fourth for cancellation since late 1995, bringing the total capital returned to shareholders to 1.25 billion stg.
Barclays' shares edged 4p lower to 1072.5 by 0820 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
